decided: 2026-11-16, by the team, before any external clip was scored
applies_to: product policy only; the paper keeps the v1 result on the original CSALT test speakers
keep: v1 temperature and v1 genuine line (low)
synthetic_line: smallest value such that at most 1% of calibration-speaker Kathbath real clips (clean and noisy, as distributed) have a calibrated spoof score at or above it
evaluation: evaluation speakers are scored once with the resulting policy, codec-matched view as headline
freevc24: a clip belongs to its target speaker; in evaluation, clips whose source speaker is a calibration speaker are dropped
stop_condition: if the new synthetic line is at or below the genuine line, stop; the team decides before anything else is run
